title: A 1 in the SQLite page size field represents 65536
summary: The two bytes at offset 16 of the database header are interpreted as big endian; when its value is 0x0001, the actual page size is 65536.
applies: SQLite 3 master database and WAL files
detail: Typical values are powers of two between 512 and 32768. Page N usually starts at (N−1) × page size.
boundary: Page numbers start from 1, and the first 100 bytes of page 1 are occupied by the database file header.
relevance: When locating page boundaries from file offsets, special encoding biases all subsequent positions.
